content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, pressing my palm against his wrist. ||| "You think they can see how much I doubt?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, pulling my hand away from his. ||| "I won't answer without knowing the truth first."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, the weight of my uncertainty heavy. ||| "I don't know what I believe anymore, Julian."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip The Answer tighter, asserting my will. ||| "I choose what happens next, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Close my eyes, feeling the tension around us. ||| mm.
